categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in real estate development, including residential and commercial building construction, sales, leasing, and property management. It also engages in interior decoration, building materials and machinery trading, and industrial factory and warehouse development. The business segments include real estate sales, leasing, apartment management, and information services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction techniques such as system formwork and precast methods, emphasizing high-quality architectural planning and construction standards. It integrates technology and data analytics for project management and customer service, and pursues green building certifications and sustainable design to enhance building performance and environmental compatibility.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include homebuyers in metropolitan Taipei and other major urban areas in Taiwan, focusing on first-time buyers and those upgrading homes. The company targets markets with strong demand for quality residential, office, and commercial properties, especially near transit hubs and mature commercial districts. It also serves tenants through its leasing and property management services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan's major metropolitan areas, including Taipei City (districts such as Shilin, Zhongzheng, Nangang, Banqiao, and Sanchong), New Taipei City, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. The company actively develops projects in prime urban locations and expanding into central and southern Taiwan regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, development, construction management, sales, and property management. It collaborates with upstream suppliers such as construction material providers and contractors but does not engage in raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include acquiring prime land with low risk and cost, enhancing project management efficiency, and adopting innovative construction methods to reduce costs and improve quality. The company emphasizes sustainable development, green building certifications, smart home technologies, and integrating property management with technology-driven customer service platforms. It also focuses on urban renewal and redevelopment projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through real estate sales (approximately 84%), leasing income (about 7%), and property management services (around 9%). A small portion comes from information services. The company also issues convertible bonds and manages investments in related subsidiaries to support operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a premium real estate developer with strong brand recognition and a reputation for high-quality projects and excellent property management. It competes primarily with other developers in the Taipei metropolitan area and major cities, differentiating through superior design, construction quality, and customer service. Market competition is more localized and project-specific rather than direct head-to-head rivalry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.09 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net profit margin of around 30%. Although revenue and profit declined compared to the previous year, the company maintains a stable asset base exceeding NT$25 billion and shareholder equity over NT$5 billion. It has a solid financial structure with ongoing investments in land and development projects to sustain growth over the next five to ten years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, aesthetically refined residential and commercial buildings with meticulous planning and construction standards. It integrates advanced technology and data analytics to enhance customer experience and property management efficiency. Its commitment to sustainability, green building certifications, and urban renewal projects further differentiates its offerings, aiming to create long-term value for customers and shareholders.
